menu:13005300:1.text: You... you can actually see me.

say:1:1623149001:1.text: The magic flow in the Skyrealm Forest has changed. Thicker, like spring water stirred with honey. But it doesn't feel hostile...
say:1:1623149001:1.source_cn: 空境森林的魔力流动有变化，像泉水掺了蜜般粘稠了起来，但...
say:1:1623149001:1.male: The magic flow in the Skyrealm Forest has changed. Thicker, like spring water stirred with honey. But it doesn't feel hostile...
say:1:1623149001:1.female: The magic flow in the Skyrealm Forest has changed. Thicker, like spring water stirred with honey. But it doesn't feel hostile...

say:2:1623149002:1.text: Solise and I have a hectic schedule. I'm afraid we can't spare the time.
say:2:1623149002:1.source_cn: 我和娑丽丝老师的课程排得很满，暂时走不开。
say:2:1623149002:1.male: Solise and I have a hectic schedule. I'm afraid we can't spare the time.
say:2:1623149002:1.female: Solise and I have a hectic schedule. I'm afraid we can't spare the time.

say:3:1623149003:1.text: Could you check it for me? Last I sensed it, the magic was near the pond by a tea party. I'd appreciate it.
say:3:1623149003:1.source_cn: 你有空的话代我去确认一下？我最后感应到那股魔力，是在茶...
say:3:1623149003:1.male: Could you check it for me? Last I sensed it, the magic was near the pond by a tea party. I'd appreciate it.
say:3:1623149003:1.female: Could you check it for me? Last I sensed it, the magic was near the pond by a tea party. I'd appreciate it.

say:0:1623150001:0.text: Yeah, something's not right. Ancestral Sense can locate the source.
say:0:1623150001:0.source_cn: 嗯……确实有点异常的魔法气息，用变形术的先祖感应探查一下。
say:0:1623150001:0.male: Yeah, something's not right. Ancestral Sense can locate the source.
say:0:1623150001:0.female: Yeah, something's not right. Ancestral Sense can locate the source.

say:1:1623152001:1.source_cn: 为什么你可以看见我呢？

choice_prompt:2:1623152001.source_cn: 为什么你可以看见我呢？

say:4:1623152004:1.text: Can you pet me? I... I'm really cold.
say:4:1623152004:1.source_cn: 你能摸摸我吗？我……我有点冷。
say:4:1623152004:1.male: Can you pet me? I... I'm really cold.
say:4:1623152004:1.female: Can you pet me? I... I'm really cold.

choice_prompt:5:1623152004.text: Can you pet me? I... I'm really cold.
choice_prompt:5:1623152004.source_cn: 你能摸摸我吗？我……我有点冷。
choice_prompt:5:1623152004.male: Can you pet me? I... I'm really cold.
choice_prompt:5:1623152004.female: Can you pet me? I... I'm really cold.

say:6:1623152005:1.text: Wooof! It's so kind of you!
say:6:1623152005:1.male: Wooof! It's so kind of you!
say:6:1623152005:1.female: Wooof! It's so kind of you!

say:7:1623152007:1.text: I had friends in the forest. We played and laughed. Now... they walk right through me, like I'm just a breeze. My voice can't reach anyone.
say:7:1623152007:1.source_cn: 我以前在森林里跑，小动物们都和我玩。可现在……他们从我...
say:7:1623152007:1.male: I had friends in the forest. We played and laughed. Now... they walk right through me, like I'm just a breeze. My voice can't reach anyone.
say:7:1623152007:1.female: I had friends in the forest. We played and laughed. Now... they walk right through me, like I'm just a breeze. My voice can't reach anyone.

say:8:1623152008:1.text: Nights here are worse than midwinter. I've tried to leave... and somehow I always end up here again.
say:8:1623152008:1.source_cn: 这里天黑的时候……比最冷的冬天还难受。我曾试着离开这里...
say:8:1623152008:1.male: Nights here are worse than midwinter. I've tried to leave... and somehow I always end up here again.
say:8:1623152008:1.female: Nights here are worse than midwinter. I've tried to leave... and somehow I always end up here again.

say:9:1623152009:1.text: C-Can you take me with you? Please...? Or I'll be left alone again, and nobody will even know.
say:9:1623152009:1.source_cn: 你……能带我离开吗？我好怕你走了，就又没人知道我还在这里了。
say:9:1623152009:1.male: C-Can you take me with you? Please...? Or I'll be left alone again, and nobody will even know.
say:9:1623152009:1.female: C-Can you take me with you? Please...? Or I'll be left alone again, and nobody will even know.

say:11:1623152006:1.text: Woof... So warm. It makes me smile, and cry, too. I don't know why.
say:11:1623152006:1.source_cn: 汪……好温暖，忽然好开心，又有点难过，不知道为什么。
say:11:1623152006:1.male: Woof... So warm. It makes me smile, and cry, too. I don't know why.
say:11:1623152006:1.female: Woof... So warm. It makes me smile, and cry, too. I don't know why.

say:12:1623152003:1.text: Woof... I used to get that a lot. But... one day, they just couldn't see me anymore.
say:12:1623152003:1.source_cn: 汪汪……以前大家也总是这么说的。但后来，他们就再也看不...
say:12:1623152003:1.male: Woof... I used to get that a lot. But... one day, they just couldn't see me anymore.
say:12:1623152003:1.female: Woof... I used to get that a lot. But... one day, they just couldn't see me anymore.

say:2:1623153002:1.text: I'm so glad you saw me. I feel warmer now!
say:2:1623153002:1.source_cn: 谢谢你关注了我，我觉得没那么冷了！
say:2:1623153002:1.male: I'm so glad you saw me. I feel warmer now!
say:2:1623153002:1.female: I'm so glad you saw me. I feel warmer now!

say:3:1623153003:1.text: The pup nuzzles your palm affectionately, then turns and walks away.
say:3:1623153003:1.source_cn: 小狗亲昵地蹭了蹭你的手心，随后转身离开。
say:3:1623153003:1.male: The pup nuzzles your palm affectionately, then turns and walks away.
say:3:1623153003:1.female: The pup nuzzles your palm affectionately, then turns and walks away.

say:4:1623153004:1.text: You can't tell if it's real, but the pup's shape thins in the air, fading into a tiny shimmer... until nothing remains but silence.
say:4:1623153004:1.source_cn: 不知是否是错觉，它的身影在空气中逐渐变得透明，最终如一...
say:4:1623153004:1.male: You can't tell if it's real, but the pup's shape thins in the air, fading into a tiny shimmer... until nothing remains but silence.
say:4:1623153004:1.female: You can't tell if it's real, but the pup's shape thins in the air, fading into a tiny shimmer... until nothing remains but silence.

say:3:1623154002:1.text: I see... Then that lonely soul has finally found its rest.
say:3:1623154002:1.source_cn: 原来如此……想必那个孤独的灵魂终于得到了安息。
say:3:1623154002:1.male: I see... Then that lonely soul has finally found its rest.
say:3:1623154002:1.female: I see... Then that lonely soul has finally found its rest.

say:4:1623154003:1.text: Thank you for taking care of it. Well done.
say:4:1623154003:1.source_cn: 感谢你跑这一趟，辛苦了！
say:4:1623154003:1.male: Thank you for taking care of it. Well done.
say:4:1623154003:1.female: Thank you for taking care of it. Well done.
